easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Aang by paying {3}{W} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, airbending the nontoken Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the second Aang trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1. Put the token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Aang's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Peregrine Drake from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
